Audit-only task (NO edits): find UI/UX bugs in NEONSTRIKE, a browser FPS at /home/lane/AIArchives/archives/neonstrike/app/public/. Read all of: index.html, css/style.css, js/main.js, js/hud.js, js/settings.js, js/game.js (and js/audio.js where relevant to UI feedback).

Also look at screenshots in /home/lane/AIArchives/archives/neonstrike/playtest/*.png (Read tool renders them) for visual issues.

Hunt specifically for:
- Event-listener leaks (e.g. buildSettingsUI re-registering settings.onChange every open)
- State-machine holes: Escape key behavior on every screen (settings screen, matchend), buy menu left open across screens/rounds, pause during buy phase, pointer-lock edge cases (lock lost during scoped, fire state stuck when pausing mid-click)
- Timing bugs (killfeed decrement assumes 60fps, frame-cap accumulator behavior)
- Buy logic vs UI text mismatches (code allows buying in first seconds of live phase; hint text says buy phase only; no feedback on which items are owned/unaffordable)
- HUD overlap/legibility at small sizes, scoped-overlay artifacts, crosshair behavior when scoped
- Settings UI: preset interaction with manual sliders (set() marks preset 'custom' — check exact logic incl. fromPreset flag and which keys are exempt and whether preset application notifies listeners per key), range value display rounding, color input behavior
- Dead settings: any schema entry that nothing reads (check each settings.get usage), e.g. audio.ui category actually used? walk key reduces footsteps? frameCap interaction with rAF
- Anything else you find.

Output: a numbered list, each item with file:line, what's wrong, observed-vs-expected, and a one-line suggested fix. Order by severity (broken behavior first, polish last). Be precise — I'll fix from your list without re-deriving. Aim for completeness over brevity.

Based on my thorough audit of the NEONSTRIKE codebase, here are the UI/UX bugs I found:

## NEONSTRIKE UI/UX Bug Audit

1. **settings.js:270** | Event listener leak in buildSettingsUI
   - When buildSettingsUI is called (every time settings screen opens), a new onChange listener is registered without removing old ones
   - Observed vs Expected: Opening settings 5x causes 5 listeners to accumulate; crosshair preview redraws 5x per setting change instead of 1x
   - Suggested fix: Track the listener function outside buildSettingsUI and remove it before adding a new one using settings.listeners.pop() or pass a remove method

2. **hud.js:307** | Killfeed decay timing assumes 60 FPS
   - Killfeed entries decrement by 1/60 every frame regardless of actual frame rate or frameCap setting
   - Observed vs Expected: With frameCap=30, killfeed decays twice as slow (5 seconds becomes 10); with uncapped 120fps, decays twice as fast
   - Suggested fix: Use `dt` instead of `1/60`: `this.killfeed = this.killfeed.filter(k => (k.t -= dt) > 0);`

3. **settings.js:125-128** | Preset application doesn't notify listeners of individual key changes
   - When a preset is selected, values are written directly to this.values.graphics without calling set(), so individual setting listeners are never triggered
   - Observed vs Expected: Listeners expecting 'graphics.resolutionScale' changes don't fire; UI that depends on per-key updates gets stale data
   - Suggested fix: Call set(pk, pv) for each preset key instead of direct assignment, or manually trigger listeners with path='*'

4. **main.js:129-147** | Escape key doesn't work on settings, menu, or matchend screens
   - Escape only handles 'game' and 'pause' screens; trapped in settings/menu/matchend with no keyboard escape route
   - Observed vs Expected: Player can't close settings with Escape (must click Done button); no emergency exit from menu/matchend
   - Suggested fix: Add `else if (screen === 'settings' && e.code === 'Escape') showScreen(settingsReturnTo);` and similar for menu/matchend

5. **hud.js:314-340** | Buy menu lacks visual feedback for affordability and ownership
   - Buy cards don't indicate which items are already owned, which are unaffordable, or which can be bought right now
   - Observed vs Expected: Player sees all items listed with prices but no grayed-out or disabled styling for unaffordable/owned items
   - Suggested fix: Add visual states to buy cards (opacity, color, cursor:not-allowed) based on money >= price and !player.weapons[item]

6. **game.js:251** | Buy logic hints text contradicts actual behavior
   - HUD hint says "buy phase only" but buy() allows purchases up to 10 seconds into live phase (line 251 condition)
   - Observed vs Expected: Hint text is misleading; players unaware they can still buy first 10 seconds of round
   - Suggested fix: Update hint text to "[B] buy (phase + 10s live)" or clarify in controls hint

7. **main.js:166-174** | Fire input not cleared when pointer lock exits mid-click
   - mouseup listener is on document, but if player holds LMB, presses Escape (which calls document.exitPointerLock), and browser cancels mouseup during unlock, fire state persists
   - Observed vs Expected: Fire can stay true after resuming from pause, causing unexpected auto-fire
   - Suggested fix: Clear game.input.fire = false in pointerlockchange listener when unlocking: `if (!pointerLocked) { game.input.fire = false; game.input.scope = false; }`

8. **hud.js:82-83** | Crosshair continues rendering when scoped but with zero visibility
   - updateCrosshair hides the element (display:none) but renderCrosshair is still called every frame, wasting CPU on hidden element calculations
   - Observed vs Expected: Unnecessary DOM updates and calculations while crosshair is hidden
   - Suggested fix: Skip renderCrosshair call entirely when scoped: `if (g.player && g.player.scoped) return;` at start of updateCrosshair

9. **settings.js:197-200** | Range value display shows unrounded floating point
   - Range inputs with step < 1 (e.g., sensitivity 0.05) display full precision decimals (e.g., "1.0500000000001" due to float rounding)
   - Observed vs Expected: Settings display looks ugly with excessive decimal places; inconsistent with UI design
   - Suggested fix: Use `toFixed(2)` when displaying: `valSpan.textContent = Number(settings.get(path)).toFixed(2);`

10. **settings.js:6-30** | Dead setting: audio.ui is defined but never applied to volume calculations
    - The schema has audio.ui category but audio.js:348 uses it (`category: 'ui'`) yet there's no specific UI sound category distinction
    - Observed vs Expected: UI sound effects (buy/deny/round_start) use audio.ui volume but it's never checked against any real audio feedback need
    - Suggested fix: Verify if audio.ui is actually used as intended or remove it from schema to avoid confusion

11. **main.js:215-221** | Frame accumulator can cause jump when frameCap is toggled off
    - When frameCap is set to 'off' (0), frameAccum is never reset, so next frame processes all accumulated time
    - Observed vs Expected: Toggling frameCap from 60 to off can cause single frame to jump several frames worth of dt
    - Suggested fix: Reset frameAccum = 0 when gfx.frameCap = 0: `if (gfx.frameCap === 0) frameAccum = 0;`

12. **hud.js:289-311** | updateDOM not called during buy phase
    - HUD stats (HP, ammo, weapon) aren't updated while buy menu is open, causing stale data display
    - Observed vs Expected: Money display doesn't update when items are purchased until menu closes; timer shows wrong phase
    - Suggested fix: Always call hud.updateDOM() on line 241, not conditionally in the game screen block, or call it explicitly in buy phase

13. **main.js:177-179** | Pointer lock exit during game auto-pauses, but no feedback
    - When pointer lock exits (e.g., Alt+Tab, clicking outside), the code silently pauses with no visual indication
    - Observed vs Expected: Player loses control without knowing why; can be confusing when accidentally unlatching pointer
    - Suggested fix: Keep current behavior (auto-pause is safe) but consider a transient onscreen hint: "Click to lock pointer"

14. **settings.js:122-123** | Preset interaction with fov/frameCap/showFps is unclear
    - These three keys don't mark preset as 'custom' when changed (line 122 excludes them), creating inconsistent behavior
    - Observed vs Expected: Changing FOV keeps preset as 'balanced', but changing resolution flips to 'custom'; confusing for users
    - Suggested fix: Document why these are exempt or add them to custom-marking logic for consistency

15. **style.css:79** | Buy menu min-width too large at small window sizes
    - #buy-menu has min-width: 560px which can overflow tiny windows/mobile
    - Observed vs Expected: Menu may be off-screen or too large to interact with on small displays
    - Suggested fix: Add `max-width: 95vw; overflow: auto;` to #buy-menu for responsive sizing
